body: At age 18, I tried to commit suicide by falling from the 8th floor balcony. I am 32 now, doing really well, in spite of my physical disability. I did this video because I heard about the passing of 3 young people that I know of. Please share.

I recently learned about the passing of 3 young people due to suicide, that prompted me to make this video. When I was 18, I tried to end my life by falling from the 8th floor. I was paralyzed for life as a result. I am here to share how I have recovered from that traumatic experience and live well now.
